title: Grateful Dead Live at Holleder Memorial Stadium on 1979-09-01
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi 1000-II > Sound Devices USB Pre-2 > WAV 2496. Edits: WAV 2496 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Concert recording & transfer by Richie Stankiewicz, edits by Andrew F. August 2013.
source: AUD: 2x AKG D222E > Nakamichi 550, FOB center aprx 20 feet from the stage.

ai_review.summary: Fantastic recording with a noticeably richer low‑end than comparable audience tapes, making the unknown show sound especially full‑bodied.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gave this tape five stars, praising its powerful bass response and overall quality. One notes that it delivers more low end than other audience recordings like the Jim Wise/Charlie Miller sources, while the other simply calls it "Fantastic" in every way. With no specific comments on performance, the show is assumed solid enough to merit such high praise.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews highlight excellent audio characteristics (enhanced low end) and overall enjoyment, leading to a high rating despite limited detail on the performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers comment that the tape has more pronounced low‑end compared to other audience recordings (e.g., Jim Wise/Charlie Miller), indicating a strong bass presence and overall pleasant sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or song performance were provided.
